reason: A bounded development diagnostic found 1 distinct vector in fixed-seed multi-sample requests and 4–5 vectors without the fixed seed. Preserve v12 and evaluate an explicit sampling correction.
hypothesis: Removing the repeated request seed restores predictive-sample diversity; forecast accuracy is not assumed to improve.
weights: Reuse existing direct-v12 weights, with no optimizer updates, no retraining, and no new persistent checkpoints
selection: Freeze the original development-selected checkpoint separately for each original seed. Do not reselect checkpoints using corrected samples or retrospective outcomes.
evaluation: Exactly the 22 original retrospective tasks / 66 horizon cells / three reused dependent October origins

sampling.reason: Unset request seed; actual samples and hashes retained. Reproduction reconstructs retained stochastic samples, not byte-identical regeneration.
sampling.fallback: Last value if fewer than48 valid vectors; no favorable resampling

comparators: same unadapted base with corrected sampling
primary_endpoint: Seven-day quantile pinball; report loss, coverage, width and sample diversity together
interpretation: Additional retrospective implementation-control study. No supplementary evidence, RL or prospective accuracy claim.
